Casting is a manufacturing process in which a liquid material (usually metal) is usually poured into a mold, which contains a hollow cavity of the desired shape, and then allowed to solidify.

**Why it is used in industry:**
1. It can produce complex shapes and intricate internal cavities.
2. Highly suitable for mass production of large components.
3. Can handle materials that are difficult to machine or weld.
4. Economical for manufacturing parts of almost any size and weight.
